sections.name: Intro

lines: Sun came up mean, sweat before the shower
left my phone out in the sun, it overheated
said "too hot to think," tapped itself to sleep
the machine clocks out — I just dig in deep
shirt stuck to my back by half past nine
the fan blows hot, but you know I'm doing fine
pour another drink, let the ice run thin
no warning light on me, I take it on the chin

lines: Came home wiped out, my feet talking back to me
the servers hum all night, they never miss a beat
my stomach growling louder than the A.C. blows
the machine don't eat — it never even knows
couch caught me like it missed me all day long
and the desert night is coming on strong
it never sleeps, so it never earns the rest
but I worked for mine — I feel it in my chest
